records.quote: — B. Inpartfc X. To make by join  xng together, to build, erect fabricate, make ,  form, construct (eyn aedifleo) fornacem
records.entryNote: Headword at 597563 ("Struo, xf, ctum 3, v a" = struo, struxi, structum); "to build, erect" sits under B. In part. 1, not in the opening sense, which is 597565-597566 "to place by or upon each other, to pile up, arrange".

note: L&S struo 的首义是 "to place by or upon each other, to pile up, arrange"，build/erect 是第二层义项 "to make by joining together, to build, erect, fabricate, make, form, construct"。「建造」成立，但严格说 pile up/arrange 才是字面本义，词库 glossEn 只写 build 略有简化，值得补「堆叠、排列」这一层。
